 Print Jackie Shroff, Sharad Kelkar's 'Kaali Kheti' teaser takes viewers into a mysterious village where farming turns sinister The teaser of Jackie Shroff and Sharad Kelkar 's upcoming film 'Kaali Kheti' has been unveiled, taking audiences into an eerie and unsettling world inside a village where Kheti is not just an activity or a way of life, but a force that seems to haunt a whole village. Rather than relying on familiar horror tropes, the first glimpse shows a folklore story with an ominous undercurrent. The teaser builds its intrigue around the idea of a village living under the shadow of something it cannot escape. Kheti appears to have a life of its own, almost like an ancient presence that has taken hold of the place and its people. There is an unsettling and atmospheric quality to this premise, particularly because it takes something so familiar to rural India and gives it an altogether sinister dimension. Watch JJackie Shroff: Wife Ayesha Left Lavish Life to Live in Mumbai Chawl ACKIE SHROFF Kaali Kheti brings agriculture to the forefront of its horror tale to tap into a fear rooted in the land, its history and the secrets that generations might have carried. It suggests a world in which the line between local belief and something far more sinister is hard to tell," the makers said, as per a press release. Written and directed by Haris Imtiyaz Khan and produced by Sana Khan, the film also features Neha Sargam, Virendra Saxena and Shaji Choudhary in pivotal roles. Produced under the banner of BlackCanvas Studio, Kaali Kheti will release in theatres on November 20, 2026.
